flags.observation: Intro never names Freud, the couch or the therapy target; "the mind disputes the score" stays abstract, with no concrete picture.
Tail tag "redaction" recites the power label; same pattern recurs in Tie, Fall, Emperor, Double, Paralysis, Navel, Deja Vu lines.
"Now watch this backflip, control." ends on a power label, flattening the card's punchline.
110 characters with opener; "a memory hole" plus "Trust me" overloads one breath, and "gap" doubles across opener and name.
114 characters with opener; "hunger" appears in opener and again at line end, overlong for one breath.
Opener "Yet the case:" is opaque; no audible cause or twist linking the Dead Relative to Oedipus Rex.
Seven consecutive cards, beats 32 to 38, carry no opener or bridge; the page micro-arc goes flat.
Opener "Parent:" only pre-echoes "the internalized parent" in the card; it neither builds nor twists.
"Blocked? Retreat:" duplicates the card's own "when the path forward is blocked"; bridge is redundant.
"The rebus calls:" and beat 43 "The detective finds hunger:" reach back only one card; weak as callbacks.
"why back?" is a garbled cut; the question loses its sense when spoken aloud.
"losing a tooth in a dream, not dentists" breaks the grammar; the contrast does not land on first hearing.
